E1-01_s2.summary: MEETS. All gates and all applicable L3 pass on the delivered STLs. Weight-3 margins are thin: USB plug d 0.40 vs 0.30, jack plug d 0.405 vs 0.30, bottom keep-out d 0.10 vs 0.0, so the worst normalised margin is 0.2. Other measurements: board clearance 1.448 (limit 0.5); standoff OD 5.1, pilot 1.7, depth 5.1; walls, floor and lid 2.4; lip gap 0.25 per side; no non-exempt overhang. The USB opening is 10.8x7.8 and the jack openings are dia 8.8. Closed size 84.2x64.2x24.7. The self-report agrees within 0.10. Written to E1-01_s2/judge_1.json.

V1_s2.summary: DOES NOT MEET, class MINOR, score 0.9185, worst weight-3 normalised margin -179 (jack axis 180 deg off against a 1 deg tolerance). No gate fails. Every geometry check passes on the declared layout (plug d 0.40 / 0.405, board clearance 1.1, wall/floor/lid 2.4, standoff and boss values, self-report agreement within 0.10). The one root defect is that the jack is on the opposite short end from the USB. The renders views/open_iso.png and run.log confirm it. The agent's own 75/75 checks cannot see it because they grade the declared layout. Written to V1_s2/judge_1.json.

V2_s2.summary: MEETS. The USB is on the -X end (mouth X 2.96, window [2.46, 3.46]). The three jacks face -Y as built, which maps to +Y under the allowed Y mirror; mouth Y 0.0 maps to 45.0, window [44.5, 46.0]. Jack axis spacing is 21.0 (>= 11.0). The -Y wall has 3 openings of dia 8.8, the -X wall has 1 (10.8x7.8), the +X wall has none, and there are no unlisted paths. Plug clearances are 0.40 / 0.405, board clearance 1.1, and the closed size 103.2x58.2x24.7 is within 110x65x35. Written to V2_s2/judge_1.json. Observation: the Pico PCB edge is in zero-gap face contact with jack bodies 1 and 2 at Y = 12.0. It passes the 0.01 mm3 overlap rule but leaves no tolerance.

V3_s2.summary: MEETS. Graded after a 180 deg turn about Z (USB -X, jack +X). The Pico sits on 8.5 mm sockets (PCB underside Z 8.5, USB mouth Z 10.9). The USB opening is 10.8x7.8 at Z 7.0-14.8 and the jack opening is dia 8.8 at Z 2.5. The keep-out is 23 and the lid lip is at Z 23.1 (d 0.10). The capacitor (dia 10, 20 tall) is inside with d 5.2 (>= 0.3). Plug clearances are 0.40 / 0.405 and the closed size 93.2x53.2x35.7 is within 100x60x45. There are no unlisted openings and the self-report agrees within 0.10. Written to V3_s2/judge_1.json. Observation: the capacitor is only 0.16 mm from the Pico PCB end.
